name: Design, Calibration, and Performance of the MINERvA Detector

summary.plain: The paper that describes how the MINERvA detector was built and calibrated to measure neutrinos hitting different kinds of atomic nuclei.
summary.technical: Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 743 (2014) 130 (arXiv:1305.5199): design, calibration and performance of the finely segmented scintillator-strip tracker with passive nuclear targets and electromagnetic/hadronic sampling calorimetry, in the NuMI near-detector hall at Fermilab.
